svg.text: Clamp points: one end of BOTH belts goes into the left X carriage half, one into the upper slot and one into the lower, teeth facing the front of

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the machine (Step 07.9); both tails are captured by the right half (Step 07.24). The toothed face never changes sides: smooth back on every plain

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: F695 stack, teeth into the motor pulley and into this belt's one toothed XY-joint idler (A: right joint, B: left). Both X runs physically lie in

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front of the X extrusion — each panel draws one behind it so the two lanes read apart. Side lanes follow the CAD: all runs inboard of the Y

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: extrusions, the other belt's single run stacked on this belt's outer run; spacing is schematic.
